description: Search original stored reviews across extensions with AND/OR field filters. Returns reviews and pagination. Example filter: {"field":"body","operator":"contains","value":"subscription"}. Use extensionEid to narrow to an extension.

filters.description: Up to 12 review filters. Example: [{"field":"rating","operator":"<=","value":2}]. Omit to browse retained reviews.

field.description: Review field to filter. name is the extension name; body is the original review text; rating is stars, not average extension rating.

operator.description: oneOf requires an array; exists/notExists need no value. >= and <= apply only to rating, helpfulCount or timestamp; contains/notContains apply to text fields.

value.description: Scalar value, or an array for oneOf. rating uses 1-5; timestamp accepts Unix seconds/milliseconds or an ISO date/time. Omit for exists/notExists.

logic.description: AND requires every filter to match; OR requires at least one.

sort.description: timestamp_desc/asc = newest/oldest first; rating_desc/asc = highest/lowest stars first.

name: extension_reviews_search
